def parse_section(text,label,n):
 # capture after matching label dimensions until next section
 pattern=rf'{label} \({n}x{n}\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n){{{n}}})'
 m=re.search(pattern,text)
 if not m: return None
 return [[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in m.group(1).strip().splitlines()]

source='''def rotate90(grid):
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    r90 = rotate90(grid)
    r180 = rotate90(r90)
    r270 = rotate90(r180)

    for r in range(n):
        out[r][:n] = grid[r][:]
        out[r][n:] = r90[r][:]

        out[r + n][n:] = r180[r][:]
